notes: Product team: building an IDE copilot plugin used by enterprise customers. Primary ask: reproducible code completions across deploys. Key requirements: model/version pinning (must be able to freeze vX.Y.Z per customer), canary & rollout controls, eval gates that automatically block rollouts when regression thresholds hit (compile failure delta, unit test pass rate, lint violations). Low-latency streaming is critical for in-editor UX (target median latency < 70ms for 32-token responses). Prefers streaming chunking + prefix KV caching to avoid re-generation. Wants deterministic seed behavior for completion portions where reproducibility matters (templates/snippets). Security: code is proprietary — VPC or on-prem deployment and KMS-managed keys required; audit logs for every token generation request. Cost sensitivity: willing to pay for dedicated capacity if ROI on developer productivity verified; optimize module required to suggest quantization/ batching to reduce token cost without harming accuracy.
